long_biography.plain_text:
A steep proposed rent increase prompted John Stamp to move The Londoner, the Bangkok brewpub he had established during the Asian financial crisis. Instead of abandoning it, he brought the business into his group's new headquarters, where it reopened in 2016 and he personally greeted returning customers.

The venue combined beer brewed on the premises with a sports pub, an open-kitchen bistro and a rooftop terrace. It served families as well as business gatherings, with children's activities and a separate menu for younger diners. Its onsite brewery produced English bitter and pilsner.

uncertainties: Research cutoff is 30 September 2026. This is a living-person assessment; the input remains Alive.

Input geography conflicts with the direct interview. The recorded vessel match is precise enough to resolve identity despite those fields. The interview's acquisition year differs slightly from the input; no vessel relationship is changed.

Thai citizenship and long-term Bangkok residence support proposed corrections. Australian citizenship could coexist but is not independently verified; it is not automatically copied into secondary nationality. London upbringing does not prove exact birthplace.

The principal fortune inference rests on the personally created industrial platform, its sustained scale and primary family continuity. Customer reserves, state power networks and corporate contract totals remain separate from personal property.

Energy denotes substantive specialised oilfield operations and support. Service is the strongest alternative for generic staffing and distribution, but it understates the historically defining integrated energy activity. Current operations still establish that core, at medium confidence.

Founder is a reasoned current economic relationship, not a mere office-title inference. Continuing family control and succession in a created private group support participation; his exact present percentage, any intergenerational gifts and portfolio values are unestablished.

The listed shareholding provides another positive asset premise, but no evidence makes it larger than the main operating group. A solitary disclosed investment cannot establish Investor or Diversified as the principal classification.
Broad Self-made is retained. The precise launch capital and arrangements before full independence are unestablished, so neither advantaged nor independent subtype is asserted from silence.
The interview calls Derek a brother; his own primary statement identifies John as his father. The primary relationship controls the short biography.
No precise birth date, year, middle name or secondary nationality is established. The birthday post uses a relative date; it does not justify back-calculating exact dates.

Forbes was checked first, with no matching personal profile. Searches covered all supported personal link types: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, Youtube, TikTok, Personal Website, Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor and Zillow, plus Wikipedia and Company Website.

Only the JST-linked Bangkok LinkedIn profile is proposed. The golf executive, Australian property agent, US adviser, British musician and historical scientist are different people. Group pages and relatives' accounts are evidence, not the owner's social links. TikTok restricted direct access.

Beer industry is the sole minimal active tag: primary ownership and sustained actual onsite production meet its operating-mandate requirement. Oil & gas is withheld because its tag contract excludes supplier relationships; no unrepresented technical-services tag is invented.

The brewpub is separately documented personal ownership. Its existence is not evidence that hospitality dominates the portfolio. The long biography describes a business decision and tangible operation rather than promotional claims.

Public corporate and personal source bodies were read as identified. The chamber PDF page was directly extracted; the interview was available in full indexed text despite intermittent direct-access failure. No gated private records or live account data were used.
